records.subject: Welcome aboard, Orchard Analytics
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so no pressure here. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything about how Orchard Analytics wants to organize its work.

Best,
Nadia
